title: Ngeli ya KI-VI (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of KI-VI take ki- for one and vi- for many, and that the noun itself changes ki- to vi- (kiti, viti).
steps: Change ki- to vi- for many.
Give the verb ki- or vi-.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the singular and plural sentences.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kiti kimoja ___meanguka." Kwa nini "vi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za KI-VI hutumia ki- kwa umoja: kiti kimeanguka. Hutumia vi- kwa wingi: viti vimeanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Viti viwili ___meanguka." Kwa nini "ki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa kiti ni viti, na kiambishi ni vi-: viti vimeanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu kimoja, ___ viwili." Kwa nini "vikitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika wingi, ki- hubadilika kuwa vi-: kitabu-vitabu, kiatu-viatu, kikombe-vikombe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya KI-VI?" Kwa nini "jiwe" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kikombe-vikombe ni KI-VI. Jiwe-mawe ni LI-YA.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kiti kimoja ___meanguka." Kwa nini "li" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za KI-VI hutumia ki- kwa umoja na vi- kwa wingi, si li-, ya-, u- wala i-.
